rules: Every exhibit in this paper is numbered "ChartN" with no space and no period, so the caption finder saw zero captions and zero mentions; each label was read off the crop and quoted from the text layer [caption.verbatim].
schema.NUMBERINGS carries no "Chart N" value, so all fifteen rows set numbering to "none" and the printed label survives only in the quote [caption.numbering].

The caption prints under the drawing for fourteen exhibits and over it for none, except Chart2 whose caption line sits under the tree and Chart10 whose caption sits under the last of its four bands [caption.position].

Chart10 is one calendar printed across pp. 12-15; the Sun.-Sat. header is on p12 and the caption on p15, so it is counted once on the caption-bearing p15 band with header_rows 1 standing for the header three pages above, and the three earlier bands are excluded split-across-pages [table.header_rows].
The schedule grids of Charts 3, 6 and 8 are boxed with vertical rules and print an ellipsis in both directions, so rows and cols count the labelled rows and columns only [table.rows] [table.cols].
Charts 3, 6 and 8 continue past the bracketed cycle inside the measured band, and their day column ends in an ellipsis, so continued is set for all three [table.continued].
The two p7 skeleton orbits are marked axes with formula labels, not plots, so they are flowchart-or-schematic rather than line [geometry.family].
Charts 11-15 are booktabs-style numeric tables with horizontal rules only; Chart12 is the single boxed one [table.rule_style].
Chart13 is three column pairs under a two-row header, hence cols 6 and header_rows 2 [table.header_rows].
No exhibit in the paper carries zebra shading, a legend or a colour bar [table.zebra] [geometry.legend].
Section paths follow printed use: Chart7 is read by the paragraph under it inside 5.2.2, and Charts 13-15 belong to 8.1, 8.2 and 8.3 respectively [place.section_path].
